contestedCalls.rationale: Verified counterexample (INV-01 fuzz + SYMBOLIC-001/002) makes this a high-confidence finding, but principal is still recoverable via the documented pauseWithdraw mechanism. The lost asset is in-motion yield (rewards on the remaining stake become unclaimable). Per C4 special-cases: 'unmatured / in-motion yield → capped at Medium'. Holding at Medium with a strong PoC.

Sanitizer argued the function 'silently breaks the documented escape hatch' which is a structural defect beyond pure centralization. Classifier disagrees: the function is onlyOwner and the trigger requires admin action (adversarial or careless). C4 explicit known-invalid: 'Reckless admin mistakes'. The structural critique belongs in the C bundle with strong remediation guidance (sweep excess only, or zero accounting, or timelock).

Sanitizer argued the magnitude bug is distinct from the trust assumption. Classifier agrees the bug is structural but the trigger is still onlyOwner. SYMBOLIC-005 confirms the gate state-machine works exactly as designed — the deficit is in the gate's design, not its implementation. C bundle.

Sanitizer flagged 'strictly worse than DEDUP-006'. Classifier agrees but it is still onlyOwner. The no-gate-at-all asymmetry deserves prominent placement in the C bundle as the strongest item but it is not a standalone High.

Sanitizer accepted the reentrancy cluster as High. Classifier downgrades because the exploit requires either a hooked rewardToken (excluded by profile §10 trust assumption and by C4 'Non-standard ERC-20' known-invalid) or a callback-capable phUSD (which it is not). This is a defense-in-depth gap, not an exploitable vulnerability under the documented trust model. Recommend nonReentrant as cheap belt-and-braces in the QA bundle.
Per sanitizer flag note: bare forfeiture is KI-4. Downstream DoS is captured by DEDUP-002 (Medium). The orphan-accumulator + missing-event angles remaining here are QA-grade. Avoids double-counting.

Funder-side value leak with narrow trigger (zero-TVL + funding overlap). No direct loss; value redistributes between funder and next entrant. Sanitizer hint felt slightly aggressive given the operational rarity.

DEDUP-006: SYMBOLIC-005 PASS (gate is delay-only — positive proof)
DEDUP-010: SYMBOLIC-005 PASS (same positive proof — confirms gate provides no MEV protection)

handoffNotes: Final tally: 0 High / 3 Medium / 14 Low / 3 Centralization. Total: 20. (DEDUP-015 is double-listed in centralization details but counted once as C.)

No High findings produced — most pre-classifier 'potential-high' hints route to Centralization because the underlying triggers are onlyOwner. This is a strict but defensible reading of C4 known-invalid 'reckless admin mistakes'.
Three Mediums all need PoCs: DEDUP-002 (verified by INV-01 + SYMBOLIC-002), DEDUP-008 (griefing replay), DEDUP-012 (phUSD-mint-revert simulation).

Four C findings should be bundled with a 'centralization concentration' overview: DEDUP-007 deserves top billing (no gate at all), DEDUP-006 second (uncapped magnitude), DEDUP-004 third (escape-hatch DoS), DEDUP-015 fourth (pauser sandwich).

QA bundle should narratively group the DEDUP-003 / DEDUP-011 / DEDUP-005 cluster (all downstream of the pauseWithdraw debt-staleness root in DEDUP-002) and the DEDUP-009 / DEDUP-010 / DEDUP-013 cluster (MEV / mempool-economic surfaces).
